clips.title: The story
paras: At Eastvale Logging Camp, timber orders from Stormwind meet the dangers of Elwynn’s eastern woods. Wolves and bears drive lumberjacks from their work, while the camp keeps timber moving toward Stormwind and nearby settlements.

Timber buyers across the Kingdom of Stormwind send orders to Eastvale Logging Camp, each with a strict deadline. Wolves and bears prowl the woods around the work sites, driving lumberjacks away and leaving cut timber behind. Supervisor Raelen directs the camp’s work, and travelers help drive off the beasts and recover the abandoned wood before deliveries fall behind schedule.

Eastvale Logging Camp has homes and horse stables where travelers can buy fine mounts. On a nearby hill above the work site, retired Marshal Haggard lives in a quiet manor. He once led the Stormwind Guard and left its service to retire far from the politics of the capital.
